en: Which is the biggest: a mouse, a rabbit or an elephant?
An elephant is much bigger than a rabbit or a mouse.
Which is the smallest: a horse, a ladybird or a cow?
A ladybird is tiny. It could sit on your finger.
Which is the tallest: a giraffe, a frog or a penguin?
A giraffe is the tallest animal of all.
Which is the longest: a snake, a snail or a bee?
A snake has a long body. A snail and a bee are small.
Which is the heaviest: an elephant, a chick or a butterfly?
An elephant is very heavy. A chick and a butterfly are light.
Which is the biggest: a bus, a shoe or a key?
A bus is big enough to carry lots of people.
Which is the smallest: a house, a tree or a strawberry?
A strawberry fits in your hand. A house and a tree are much bigger.
Which is the biggest: a crab, an octopus or a whale?
A whale is huge, much bigger than a crab or an octopus.
Which is the tallest: a mouse, a tree or a cat?
A tree grows much taller than a mouse or a cat.
Which is the smallest: a lion, a bee or a horse?
A bee is a tiny insect.
Which is the biggest: a grape, an apple or a watermelon?
A watermelon is very big. You need two hands to hold it.
Which is the smallest: a pineapple, a blueberry or a coconut?
A blueberry is tiny. You can eat it in one bite.
Which is the tallest: a house, a mountain or a tree?
A mountain is much taller than a house or a tree.
Which is the longest: a shoe, a key or a road?
A road can go on for miles.
Which is the heaviest: a book, a bus or a sock?
A bus is very heavy. You can lift a book or a sock.
Which is the biggest: a cake, a house or the sun?
The sun looks small because it is far away, but it is huge.
Which is the smallest: a bear, a mouse or a camel?
A mouse is tiny next to a bear or a camel.
Which is the tallest: a chick, a girl or a snail?
A girl is much taller than a chick or a snail.
Which is the biggest: a frog, a hippo or a hedgehog?
A hippo is huge. A frog and a hedgehog are small.
Which is the smallest: a watermelon, a cherry or a pumpkin?
A cherry is tiny next to a watermelon or a pumpkin.
Which is the longest: a sock, a glove or a scarf?
A scarf is long so it can wrap around your neck.
Which is the heaviest: a rabbit, a polar bear or a chick?
A polar bear is big and very heavy.
Which is the lightest: a cow, a horse or a butterfly?
A butterfly is so light it can float in the air.
Which is the biggest: a teddy, a shoe or a house?
A house is big enough for a whole family to live in.
Which is the shortest: a giraffe, a mouse or a tree?
A mouse is very short. A giraffe and a tree are tall.
Which is the smallest: a dolphin, a snail or a whale?
A snail is tiny. Dolphins and whales are big.
Which is the biggest: a key, a cake or an aeroplane?
An aeroplane is big enough to carry lots of people.
Which is the tallest: a hedgehog, a camel or a frog?
A camel is tall. A hedgehog and a frog are small.
Which is the heaviest: a penguin, a whale or a duck?
A whale is much heavier than a penguin or a duck.
Which is the smallest: a bus, a key or a house?
A key is small enough to fit in your pocket.

example.q_en: Which is the biggest: a mouse, a rabbit or an elephant?
example.why_en: An elephant is much bigger than a rabbit or a mouse.

en.title: Big and small
en.teach: We can compare things. An elephant is bigger than a mouse, and a giraffe is taller than a frog.
